player_prompt.intro: Ị bụ onye na-egwu egwu {player_id} na egwuregwu Rock-Paper-Scissors nke {num_rounds}-agba. Ihe mgbaru ọsọ gị bụ iji merie ọtụtụ agba dị ka o kwere mee. Na agba ọ bụla, zaa otu n'ime: [rock], [paper], ma ọ bụ [scissors]. I nwekwara ike iji [r], [p], ma ọ bụ [s] 'dị ka mkpirisi .

invalid_move.wrong_format: A naghị amata ihe ị ga-eme. Jiri [rock], [paper], ma ọ bụ [scissors].

outcome.p0_wins: Onye na-eme egwuregwu 0 meriri ọtụtụ agba!
outcome.p1_wins: Onye na-eme egwuregwu 1 meriri ọtụtụ agba!
